notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
Grenzo has power equal to or greater than the additional creature's base power.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting the creature into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
